name: Vilebranch Hooligans
label: Quest
description: Smith Slagtree of Revantusk Village says Vilebranch trolls invaded the village and stole his tools. He keeps spare tools, but the stolen set was a gift…
intro: Smith Slagtree of Revantusk Village says Vilebranch trolls invaded the village and stole his tools. He keeps spare tools, but the stolen set was a gift from a kind-hearted gnome who saved his life when he was a young orc, and he wants it back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vilebranch scum invaded our village and stole my tools! I have backup tools but the set they stole was a gift given to me by a kind hearted gnome that saved my life when I was a young orc.
I want those tools back, friend - they mean the world to me.
Markhor reported that the tools were spotted near the Agol'watha and Shaol'watha temples.
Those temples are in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Watch out for the Vilebranch trolls of the region, friend. They are ruthless, murderous filth.

clips.title: Completion
paras: My tools! You found them! Oh glorious day! Thank you, friend.
